## Surface

1. **sweep (windows)** — collection error, many test modules: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fcntl'` (fcntl is Unix-only; imported at import/collection time). Windows tier cannot even collect.
2. **sweep (py3.14)** — `tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor_locks.py::test_a_contended_fcntl_leg_reads_as_held` FAILED: `RuntimeError: Network access is forbidden in unit/scripts tests` (unmocked network call; needs a mock or `@pytest.mark.allow_network`). 1 failed / 18330 passed.
3. Also red in the same run: `sweep (py3.14t)`, `sweep (py3.15)`, `sweep (macos, full suite)`, `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` — not individually triaged; likely overlapping causes.
